title: 1RB1RE_1RC0RF_0LD---_1LE1LD_1RA0LB_0RE1LC: no halt in 2.66·10<sup>13</sup> steps (plain simulation in checked pieces)
text: The plain simulation, in 109 checked pieces, covers the first 2.66·10<sup>13</sup> steps with no halt, and has caught up with the fixed accelerator (2.668·10<sup>13</sup>), which is slow in the fourth hand-over that started at about 2.4·10<sup>13</sup>.
